neighbours.label: the word ' traditional' and its near-synonym ' conventional', as opposed to 'old', 'usual' and 'ordinary' in the same frames
fire: In traditional Japanese homes, shoes stay at the door.
Unlike conventional ovens, these cook with steam.
Grandfather still prefers traditional methods of curing ham.
Most conventional cars burn gasoline in the engine.
The new school replaced traditional grades with written reports.
Critics of conventional farming point to soil loss.
She wore a traditional wedding dress from her region.
This model beats traditional passive funds on cost.
quiet: In old Japanese homes, shoes stay at the door.
Unlike gas ovens, these cook with steam.
Grandfather still prefers simple methods of curing ham.
Most ordinary cars burn gasoline in the engine.
The new school replaced numeric grades with written reports.
Critics of industrial farming point to soil loss.
She wore a long wedding dress from her region.
This model beats typical passive funds on cost.

notes: The card's top examples are all ' traditional'. 'Conventional' rests on one probe (0.60); ' traditionally' reached 0.45 in a probe.
